apps.localizedDescription: Log what you spend in seconds, keep a daily streak, and see where your money goes. Pip cheers you on.
apps.versionDescription: Backup & restore: Pip saves a copy of everything to iCloud Drive every day, and brings it all back after a reinstall. Turn it on in You → Backup.
